verses.1: Hear my words, O nations! Listen to me, even those far away. Let God call me from where I am. I will remember my name.
verses.2: And he put his mouth like a sharp sword on my lips. He covered me with his anger, and he made me suffer greatly in his wrath. He hid me from everyone’s sight.
verses.3: And he said to me, “You, O Israel, who are the one in whom I will manifest my glory.”
verses.4: And I said to the empty space: “I am tired of this suffering and pain. My strength has gone. I can no longer carry out my duties towards Jehovah and my obligations towards God.”
verses.5: And now, say, “Lord my Creator, I will make him a servant who will serve me. May Jacob return to him, and may Israel be gathered together and honored in the eyes of the Lord my God.”
verses.6: And he said, “From you I will make a servant who will build Jacob’s temples. He will restore Israel’s tribes. I will give you to the nations as my savior, until the end of the earth.”
verses.7: Thus said Jehovah: “I will make Israel holy, so that they may be worthy to serve Me. Kings shall fear Me, and they shall bow down before Me, so that Jehovah, who is holy, may be honored among the Israelites. And I will choose you.”
verses.8: Thus said Jehovah: “In your time of need, I will answer you. On the day of salvation, I will help you and provide for you. I will make you a covenant with me, so that you may build a land and give it its own rivers.”
verses.9: And they said to the uncircumcised: “Go out into the darkness. Walk along the paths of evil. May you be destroyed in every direction.”
verses.10: They shall not starve or suffer from thirst. They shall not be deprived of food or water. For they will be treated with compassion, and they will be cared for by those who are responsible for the waters.
verses.11: And I have set all the mountains in their proper places, and my paths are clear.
verses.12: Here, these people come from afar. And here, others come from the mountains and from the sea. And some come from China itself.
verses.13: The heavens rejoiced, and the earth was filled with light. The mountains were filled with joy, as if Jehovah had comforted His people. The poor and needy were rewarded.
verses.14: And Zion said, “Let Yahweh and my God leave me alone!”
verses.15: A woman forgets her child that was born from her womb. But I will not forget you either.
verses.16: Also, on your shoulders, I will write the laws of your lives, always against you.
verses.17: May your children be destroyed and ruined by you. May they be taken away from you.
verses.18: Let your eyes look around, and see that they all have been destroyed by your hand. O LORD, I cry out to you! For they all are like straw that has been trampled and twisted into a mass of chaos.
verses.19: For your ruins and your foundations have been destroyed, and your land has been laid waste. Now I will make you a place for those who sit in it, and they will be removed from your ruins.
verses.20: Still, your sons will say to me, “Where can I find a place to rest and sit down?”
verses.21: And you said in your heart, “Who will give me these? I am alone and abandoned. Who will raise them up? I remain alone here. Where are they?”
verses.22: As Adonai Yehovah has said, “Behold, I will take you to nations and peoples far away. I will bring your sons back in battle, and your daughters will be carried captive.”
verses.23: And they shall be kings, and their queens shall be your daughters. They will reign over the land, and your feet shall walk on it. And you shall know that I am the LORD, who will never abandon them.
verses.24: Let a cruel tyrant be taken away, and let the righteous rule.
verses.25: For thus said the LORD: “Even my servants will be taken away and enslaved. My enemies will be defeated. I will fight against your enemies, and I will save my people.”
verses.26: And I will eat your flesh and drink your blood. Their blood will be used as a sacrifice, and all living things will know that I, Jehovah, am your savior and redeemer, the warrior of Jacob.
